description:
One day, a zombie virus, presumed to have originated in Seoul, spreads without any known cause, and the country is devastated in just a few days. Han Jun-sik, a hikikomori who dreamed of the end of the world, used the underground warehouse of the supermarket where he worked as a refuge...


**Original Webtoon:**
